# TextAreaText

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Text Areas](BlitzPlus-Text-Areas)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
TextAreaText:String textarea:Int32, pos:Int32=0, len:Int32=-1, units:Int32=1
```

## Description

Reads the text, all of it or a part. Line breaks are given as `Chr$(13)`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `textarea` | Int32 | required | Handle of a text area. |
| `pos` | Int32 | `0` |  |
| `len` | Int32 | `-1` |  |
| `units` | Int32 | `1` | 1 counts characters, 2 counts lines. Defaults to 1. |

**Returns:** The text.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Read", 10, 10, 300, 150, Desktop(), 3)
area = CreateTextArea(10, 10, 270, 90, win)
SetGadgetText area, "one" + Chr$(13) + "two" + Chr$(13) + "three"
SetGadgetText win, TextAreaText(area, 1, 1, 2) ; the second line
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
